display_long_description: Gobbo is an online multiplayer game that mixes horror, exploration, and the movement style from Gorilla Tag to make something that’s fast, fun, and easy to pick up. You don’t need to be super skilled to enjoy it, and you can go at your own pace whether that means running around with friends or taking your time exploring on your own. The goals are simple, so you can jump in and start having fun right away. You can play solo if you want something a little more tense, or hop into a game with other people for a more chaotic and social experience. There are in game moderators too, so no one’s left out and the vibe stays friendly. You can make your character your own with custom colors, a name, and different cosmetics so people can spot you right away. Whether you’re creeping through dark hallways, running through a dark forest, or just hanging out with others, Gobbo is about having a good time your way with a bit of horror mixed in.
